How I work
It starts with design.

I begin with the problem, not the screen. Frame, grid and boxes in grey first, then type, paper, ink and a single accent. If it works in grey, it will work in colour.

How I work
Then it gets built.

I sketch and iterate in Figma, then move to code early. I build the real component with every state, so what you see is the real thing.

How I work
Then engineering joins in.

I open a pull request in the same repo as the engineers. They add the logic behind it, and we talk through every change.

How I work
Then we review it together.

The checks run, we review it as a team, and I test it with real people before anything goes out.

How I work
And then it’s live.

What goes out matches what I designed. Same pixels in production, nothing lost along the way.

I use AI tools to build faster. The decisions stay mine.
